title: VANDIRA Multi-Provider AI Runtime Registry
purpose: Connect VANDIRA to multiple server-side AI providers with automatic fallback, while keeping election evidence retrieval independent from model choice.

providers.name: Cloudflare Workers AI
providers.free_note: Workers AI currently includes a daily free allocation on the Workers Free plan; availability is model-specific.

providers.name: Google Gemini API
providers.free_note: Google publishes free-tier model availability and limits; exact quotas can change.

providers.name: Groq API
providers.free_note: Groq publishes Free Plan rate limits by model; exact limits are account/model dependent.

providers.name: OpenRouter
providers.free_note: OpenRouter offers free models and an openrouter/free router, with free-model request limits.

providers.name: Custom OpenAI-compatible provider
providers.free_note: Optional compatibility path for another provider or self-hosted endpoint.

routing_policy: Election evidence retrieval is model-independent and runs before synthesis.
Prefer configured provider in explicit request mode; otherwise use automatic cascade.
A provider failure or quota error falls back to the next configured provider.
No provider is allowed to invent missing election facts.
Provider credentials are never exposed to client code.
Free-tier status is not treated as a permanent guarantee.
